name: Mandrill Manifest!
summary: Welcome to Mandrill Manifest! This is a Gorilla-Locomotion used game created by the one and only Nj0820! In this game, you can swing from the trees in Forest, mine and get super rich in Crystals, or stretch your spine in the Zero-Gravity zone! There are a ton of fun things to do here, so what are you waiting for? Swing on in!
